test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A - B' means 'A is the mother of B'.

'A × B means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A ÷ B means 'A is the sister of B'.

If P ÷ Q - R + S - K × L, then which of the following statements is correct?.
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64886493bb300a8ef31f1507b44ed538becdacd7a98b6e26f230006fddf89fb3.png] 

According to the given information,

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Number

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 × 
 ÷ 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
Of B

 
 
 

The given expression is : 

'P ÷ Q - R + S - K × L' → P is sister of Q, Q is mother of R, R is brother of S, S is mother of K, K is husband of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3079c41acf7601cf96f6c6b4322c74f40552623f4b65e40855f1029b40ac0dab.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"R is K's mother's brother".**
